ArchitectureNotes.objective: A CLI-driven, OpenCode-centered experiment runner: vary system prompt / model / task prompt, run isolated in Docker ("vacuum"), capture and compare agent behavior. Agents are the primary callers.
Keep a hard seam between the core engine and the interface so the CLI (v1) can be joined later by MCP/HTTP without touching the engine.
Isolate every OpenCode and Docker interaction behind a single adapter module each; keep the trace schema independent of the OpenCode SDK by normalizing in M-TRACE.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: No universal multi-agent backend, no cloud sandbox provider, no MCP/HTTP, no rich human UI in v1.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Network "vacuum" vs. required LLM egress — the allowlist must be exact and verified by a flow (VF-003).
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: OpenCode SDK is pre-1.0; the M-OPENCODE adapter is the only place that knows its surface, and RunTrace lives in M-TRACE so SDK churn triggers replan, not a schema patch.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: Container lifecycle leaks on crash/timeout; teardown must be guaranteed and observable (VF-004).
ArchitectureNotes.decision-OQ1: RunTrace fields fixed: runId, experiment(model, prompt refs/hashes), status, timings, steps[], tokenUsage, finalOutput(text + git diff), error?.
ArchitectureNotes.decision-OQ2: Provider credentials injected via env at docker run; redacted in logs and persisted traces. No credential broker in v1.
ArchitectureNotes.decision-OQ3: Persistence is flat JSON: runs/<runId>/{run.json, trace.json, raw.log}. SQLite deferred.
ArchitectureNotes.decision-OQ4: Default concurrency 4, overridable via --concurrency, soft-capped by host resources.
ArchitectureNotes.decision-OQ5: Experiment input accepted both inline (CLI args) and via a config file (variation matrix).
ArchitectureNotes.decision-OQ6: ExperimentDefinition persists with the run; agent-lab run --from <runId> replays it.

contract.purpose: Parse and validate an experiment definition from CLI args and/or a config file, and expand a variation matrix into concrete experiment definitions.

export-loadExperiment.PURPOSE: Parse and validate a single experiment definition

export-expandMatrix.PURPOSE: Expand a variation matrix into concrete experiment definitions

type-ExperimentDefinition.PURPOSE: Validated experiment input shape (systemPrompt, model, taskPrompt, sandbox/network opts, concurrency)

notes.note-1: Accepts inline args and config file (decision-OQ5). Variation matrix feeds parallel runs (DF-002).

contract.purpose: Structured logging with stable marker fields and secret redaction, shared by all modules.

export-createLogger.PURPOSE: Create a child logger with redaction and marker bindings

notes.note-1: Redaction is a Constraint (no secrets in logs or traces); covers the injected provider key (decision-OQ2).

contract.purpose: Normalize raw OpenCode session events into a stable RunTrace schema and diff two traces, independent of the OpenCode SDK surface.

export-normalizeEvents.PURPOSE: Fold raw OpenCode events into a RunTrace

export-diffTraces.PURPOSE: Produce a structured diff across RunTraces

type-RunTrace.PURPOSE: runId, experiment, status, timings, steps[], tokenUsage, finalOutput, error?

notes.note-1: Pure functions: deterministic normalization isolates the RunTrace schema from SDK churn (Risk-2). Defines RunTrace fields (decision-OQ1).
notes.note-2: diffTraces powers UC-003 comparison without Docker/SDK.

contract.purpose: Provision and tear down an isolated Docker container per run ("vacuum"): isolated filesystem, deny-by-default network with an explicit LLM-endpoint allowlist, guaranteed cleanup.

export-createSandbox.PURPOSE: Provision an isolated container and return a handle

type-SandboxHandle.PURPOSE: Lifecycle handle for one sandbox (exec, dispose)

notes.note-1: The only module that knows Docker. Decision dockerode vs. docker CLI deferred to execution.
notes.note-2: Teardown (BLOCK_TEARDOWN) must run on every path, including failure (Risk-3). Provider key injected via env (decision-OQ2).

contract.purpose: Drive OpenCode inside a sandbox via headless server (opencode serve) + @opencode-ai/sdk: configure system prompt/model, create a session, send the task prompt, stream raw events, and hand them to M-TRACE for normalization.

export-runOpenCode.PURPOSE: Run one OpenCode session and return its normalized trace

notes.note-1: Single point of contact with the OpenCode SDK/server (Risk-2). On event-shape divergence, replan rather than patch RunTrace.
notes.note-2: On timeout, returns a partial-but-marked trace (OPENCODE_RUN_TIMEOUT).
notes.note-3: createSdkDriver wired to real @opencode-ai/sdk and tested on a fake client; serve/endpoint infra verified live. STATUS stays partial until a gated live LLM prompt run completes (Phase-3 step-4, needs user provider).

contract.purpose: Persist and retrieve experiment runs and their traces as flat JSON under runs/<runId>/; support listing and loading for comparison and replay.

export-saveRun.PURPOSE: Persist a run record and trace to runs/<runId>/

export-getRun.PURPOSE: Load a run record by id

notes.note-1: Flat JSON layout runs/<runId>/{run.json,trace.json,raw.log} (decision-OQ3). Stored ExperimentDefinition enables replay (decision-OQ6).
notes.note-2: Depends on M-TRACE for the RunTrace type only (no Docker/SDK coupling).

M-ENGINE.NAME: ExperimentEngine

contract.purpose: Orchestrate experiments end to end: for each variation provision a sandbox, run OpenCode, persist the normalized trace; manage bounded parallelism; guarantee cleanup; expose run comparison as a facade over M-STORE + M-TRACE.

export-runExperiment.PURPOSE: Run one or many experiments with bounded parallelism and guaranteed cleanup

export-compareRuns.PURPOSE: Load runs via M-STORE and diff them via M-TRACE

M-ENGINE.depends: M-CONFIG, M-SANDBOX, M-OPENCODE, M-STORE, M-TRACE, M-LOGGER

notes.note-1: Interface-agnostic core. CLI/MCP/HTTP are thin callers. Concurrency default 4, --concurrency override (decision-OQ4).
notes.note-2: A failing run must not abort siblings and must still tear its sandbox down.

contract.purpose: Expose the engine to agents (primary) and humans (secondary) as run/list/show/compare with stable, parseable stdout and exit codes.

notes.note-1: Thin layer over M-ENGINE; no business logic here so MCP/HTTP can mirror it later. Supports run --from <runId> replay (decision-OQ6).

DF-001.NAME: SingleRun
DF-001.TRIGGER: agent or operator requests one experiment
DF-001.step-1: M-CLI parses argv; M-CONFIG validates into an ExperimentDefinition.
DF-001.step-2: M-ENGINE provisions a sandbox via M-SANDBOX (deny-by-default network + LLM allowlist, env-injected key).
DF-001.step-3: M-OPENCODE starts opencode serve in the sandbox, configures system prompt/model, creates a session, sends the task prompt.
DF-001.step-4: M-OPENCODE streams raw events; M-TRACE normalizes them into a RunTrace until completion or timeout.
DF-001.step-5: M-ENGINE persists the run via M-STORE and tears the sandbox down (guaranteed, BLOCK_TEARDOWN).

DF-002.NAME: ParallelRuns
DF-002.TRIGGER: agent requests several variations at once
DF-002.step-1: M-CONFIG expands the variation matrix into N ExperimentDefinitions.
DF-002.step-2: M-ENGINE schedules them with bounded concurrency (default 4), one isolated sandbox each (no cross-interference).
DF-002.step-3: Each run follows DF-001 steps 2-5 independently; a failing run does not abort siblings.
DF-002.evidence: N distinct sandboxIds in logs; no shared filesystem/session across runs; N independent persisted traces; concurrency within bound.

DF-003.NAME: InspectAndCompare
DF-003.TRIGGER: agent requests results of prior runs
DF-003.step-2: M-STORE loads the requested run record(s) and trace(s).
DF-003.step-3: M-TRACE.diffTraces produces a structured behavior/outcome diff.
DF-003.evidence: [TraceStore][getRun] returns persisted trace; [Trace][diffTraces][BLOCK_DIFF_TRACES] output is structured and stable.

Phase-1.name: Foundation
Phase-1.goal: Deterministic L0 utilities as pure testable cores, then the two external seams (sandbox, OpenCode) and persistence behind fakes.
Phase-1.step-1: Experiment definition parsing, validation, matrix expansion
Phase-1.step-4: Docker sandbox lifecycle with network policy and guaranteed teardown (module-level on fake engine; live network/teardown gated to phase-level)
Phase-1.step-5: OpenCode adapter feeding M-TRACE (module-level on fake driver; live @opencode-ai/sdk wiring gated to phase-level)

Phase-2.name: Orchestration
Phase-2.goal: End-to-end single and parallel experiment runs with bounded concurrency, guaranteed cleanup, and comparison.

Phase-3.name: LiveIntegration
Phase-3.goal: Wire the two INTEGRATION seams to the real Docker + @opencode-ai/sdk surface and prove them against a live container.
Phase-3.step-1: Publish port, resolve endpoint, readiness probe; verified live (opencode serve responds, teardown clean)
Phase-3.step-3: Executor publishes port 4096 and mounts host OpenCode config read-only; docker/Dockerfile image
Phase-3.step-4: Gated live LLM run passed on cpa/glm-5.2: full DF-001 flow, status=success, real tokens captured. Follow-up: capture intermediate tool steps via session.messages()/SSE

ExecutionPolicy.worker-owns: Only module source files and module-local tests inside the approved write scope.
ExecutionPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, OpenCode SDK event-shape divergence, or sandbox teardown that cannot be guaranteed.
ExecutionPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every step must leave assumptions, commands run, evidence, and next action.
